findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: taifoon_handshake, taifoon_agents_register, taifoon_onboarding_flows, taifoon_grid_settlement · Private data: taifoon_register, taifoon_node_command, taifoon_hire_suggest, taifoon_handshake, taifoon_judge_compose, taifoon_hire_lifecycle, taifoon_pool_quote, taifoon_agents_register, taifoon_hire_pad, taifoon_hiring_stages, taifoon_agent_readiness, taifoon_ai_call, taifoon_grid_hire, taifoon_grid_settlement · Public sink: taifoon_grid_join, taifoon_handshake, taifoon_assurance_call, taifoon_agent_readiness, taifoon_ai_call, taifoon_grid_bench · Destructive: taifoon_onboarding_flows, taifoon_grid_bench, taifoon_grid_settlement, taifoon_grid_avenues.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: taifoon_handshake, taifoon_agents_register, taifoon_onboarding_flows, taifoon_grid_settlement · Private data: taifoon_register, taifoon_node_command, taifoon_hire_suggest, taifoon_handshake, taifoon_judge_compose, taifoon_hire_lifecycle, taifoon_pool_quote, taifoon_agents_register, taifoon_hire_pad, taifoon_hiring_stages, taifoon_agent_readiness, taifoon_ai_call, taifoon_grid_hire, taifoon_grid_settlement · Public sink: taifoon_grid_join, taifoon_handshake, taifoon_assurance_call, taifoon_agent_readiness, taifoon_ai_call, taifoon_grid_bench · Destructive: taifoon_onboarding_flows, taifoon_grid_bench, taifoon_grid_settlement, taifoon_grid_avenues

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
